hypothesis: On professionally annotated full-scope gold the rig's paired advantage persists under the print-perfect invented allowance of 0.15, repetition stays zero, and absolute CER lands materially below the AncientDoc numbers because gold-scope confounds are absent.
decision: The rig's advantage holds on real human gold and the absolute numbers confirm that much of the AncientDoc residue was gold-side: v2 macro CER 0.209306 versus baseline 0.268503 (median 0.187500 versus 0.271468, 16 of 23 pairs), invented characters collapse to 0.009600 mean under the print-perfect 0.15 limit, and every protected corpus slice improves. Two findings feed the next harness iteration: repetition is not fully dead at case grain (two dense MTH1200 Gaoli commentary pages measured 0.1739 and 0.2273 case-level repetition inside a passing aggregate), and the image-only baseline flaked a second duplicate submission in about sixty sessions while the toolbelt has never flaked, so the sealed layered submission contract is also the more reliable one.
